title: 赠汪伦
author: 李白
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. All four paper edges are full bleed: no frame, rectangular picture boundary, green outer border, UI, collage, modern objects, written characters, title, calligraphy, stamp, seal, logo or watermark. Not a generic interchangeable landscape: use the exact poem's setting, season, emotional tone and main visual moment. Paint no words from the poem.
Specific scene: A poet in a small wooden boat turning toward a friendly man leading a few rhythmic farewell steps on a simple riverbank, deep clear pool beyond. Warm human connection, not a grand staged performance.
Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 赠汪伦 — 李白
李白乘舟将欲行，忽闻岸上踏歌声。
桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪伦送我情。
